property.android:value: This is the main, critical service necessary to mediate application usage detection and blocking as well as counting towards the user's set usage limits and launch counts. It is started and remains active according to the user's blocking setup - it provides the functions of Quick Block, blocking schedules and Strict Mode in terms of application blocking. It also keeps the periodic application-usage measurement running for the Time Nudge reminder, which the user enables in settings and which needs current usage data to notify them after a set time in the apps they chose.

This is the main, critical service necessary to mediate application usage detection and blocking as well as counting towards the user's set usage limits and launch counts. It is started and remains active according to the user's blocking setup - it provides the functions of Quick Block, blocking schedules and Strict Mode in terms of application blocking. It also keeps the periodic application-usage measurement running for the Time Nudge reminder, which the user enables in settings and which needs current usage data to notify them after a set time in the apps they chose.

This service manages the countdown towards a blocking schedule activation, as per a user's settings. The user may choose to set how long before a blocking schedule is activated the countdown starts. This service then shows a countdown notification in order for the user to make sure to finish any work in apps that may be blocked once the countdown ends.

This service manages the countdown towards the time when and active blocking schedule which has been paused is resumed, as per a user's settings. The user may choose to set how long before a blocking schedule is resumed the countdown starts. This service then shows a countdown notification in order for the user to make sure to finish any work in apps that may be blocked once the countdown ends.
